title: 11eNexus
homeHelp: Pick a game to join its channel, bring a paused game back or choose your notifications.
panelPlayHelp: Active games are open to Syndiqué members. Visit the archives to bring an old channel back.
panelNotificationsHelp: Choose notifications for your games or alerts for new additions.
panelAddHelp: Missing a game? Search its name, check the right edition and confirm its addition.
personalMenuHint: Buttons open a menu only you can see.
browseHelp_active: Choose a game to open its channel or receive notifications. Want something else? Check the archives.
browseHelp_archived: These games are paused and their history is preserved. Choose one, then use Bring this game back to reopen its channel.
browseHelp_all: Every catalogue game is here. Choose a game or search a name, including archived games.
browseHelp_subscribed: These are the games you receive mentions for. Open a game to turn them off; use All to choose more.
chooseGameHelp: Open the list below and choose the game you’re interested in.
emptySearchHelp: No matching games. Try another name or use Add a game to look for a new entry.
emptyHelp_active: No active games right now. Open the archives to bring one back.
emptyHelp_archived: No paused games right now. Open channels are listed under Active games.
emptyHelp_all: The catalogue is empty for now. You can search for a game to add.
emptyHelp_subscribed: You haven’t chosen any notifications yet. Open All, choose a game and enable its notifications.
gameHelp_active: The channel is open: join the conversation whenever you like. You can read it without enabling notifications.
gameHelp_archived: This game is paused. To play again, you can bring its channel back to the active games.
gameHelp_unavailable: The team needs to check this game before it can be brought back.
gameNeedsHelp: An administrator needs to check this game. You can return to the catalogue and choose another one.
subscriptionHelp: Subscribing gives you game mentions; it does not change channel access.
quotaPending: The team needs to check one of your previous actions before another addition or revival.
candidateConfirmHelp: Is this the right game? Check the studio and edition before confirming.
candidateImageHelp: The image could not be prepared. Choose another entry or send the game to the team.
noCandidateHelp: No usable entries for this search. Try another name or propose the game to the team.
manualRequestHelp: Can’t find the right entry? Send its name and an official link to the team; follow the reply under My requests.
adminRequestsHelp: Open a request to check the game, inspect its link and prepare a reply to the member.
requestsHelp: Find the games you proposed to the team. Open a request to read the reply or add missing information.
noAdminRequests: No requests to review right now.
noRequestsHelp: You have no requests yet. Search for your game first; if no entry fits, you can propose it to the team.
requestHelp_pending: Your request is saved. The team will check the game; you can find their reply here.
requestHelp_needs_info: The team needs more information. Read the reason, then update your request using the button below.
requestHelp_accepted: The game was approved. Open its page to find the channel, bring it back or choose notifications.
requestHelp_rejected: The team did not approve this request. Read the reason below, then return to your other games.
modalBackHint: Close this window to return to the menu. Nothing is sent until you submit.
searchModalHelp: Search every game on the server, including the archives.
addSearchModalHelp: Search for the game to add. If the server already has it, you’ll find its page.
requestModalHelp: Give the game’s name and an official link to help the team find the right edition.
amendModalHelp: Update the information using the clarification requested by the team.
notifyModalHelp: Your message will be posted in the game channel with a mention of its subscribers.
gameNameHint: The game name is enough. Include its edition if needed.
officialLinkHint: An official or store page starting with https://.
notifyFieldHint: Suggest a session: time, open spots, plans…
gameAlreadyHere: This game is already in the catalogue: you can use its page directly.
resourceAuditDefinition: Tracking is checked by ID in SQLite, even when names differ. Untracked means no known association, not unused: check subscriber counts and listed references. Resources from retired games or unfinished operations are identified separately. This report does not modify Discord.
resourceAuditRenameHint: Suggestions follow the catalogue name. Review before any renaming script; no names have been changed.
catalogueSummary: {{total}} games in the catalogue · {{active}} active · {{archived}} archived
catalogueFilterHint: Use the Archived filter to find and bring back other games.
archiveHint: Bringing this game back makes its channel visible to the community. Without a new human message within 48 hours, it returns to the archives.
candidate: Select the exact game; check its studio and release information.
confirmCreate: Add {{game}} to the server? A visible channel will be created. Without a first human message in 48 hours it will return to the archives.
requestRecorded: Your proposal for {{game}} is recorded. An administrator will verify its identity and image.
notificationSent: The game role has been mentioned in its channel.
recycledHint: Your preference is saved. The notification role will be restored when the game returns.
adminStatus: {{games}} games · {{pending}} pending proposals · {{operations}} operations requiring review
proposalAlert: A game request needs review: {{game}}. Open the Administration panel → Requests.
partial: An operation for {{game}} needs review. Open Administration → Maintenance before retrying.
capacityAlert: Archiving {{game}} is blocked by capacity or permissions. Administrative action is required.
activityUnavailable: Activity could not be fully checked for {{game}}; automatic archiving is skipped.
forbidden: You need the Syndiqué role to use this panel.
adminOnly: This action is reserved for administrators.
notFound: This item no longer exists. Open the panel again.
invalidInput: Check the information entered and try again.
catalogueUnavailable: New game search is temporarily unavailable. You can still use known games or submit a proposal with an official link.
invalidImage: This image cannot be used. An administrator can verify the proposal or select a parent game’s icon.
needsReview: An administrator needs to verify this game or its icon. Submit a proposal or contact the team.
cooldown: You can create or bring back another game in {{minutes}} minutes.
proposalCooldown: You already submitted a proposal in the last 24 hours. Check its status under My proposals.
notificationCooldown: Please wait before using Notify players again for this game.
mentionHint: To notify subscribers, mention {{role}} directly in the conversation.
capacity: There is no room for this action. An administrator must free up space; no new game has been announced as ready.
iconsUnavailable: Role icons are unavailable on this server. An administrator needs to review this action.
incomplete: Discord could not be fully checked. No destructive reconciliation has been performed.
inProgress: An operation is already in progress. Please check the game again shortly.
blocked: This game is currently unavailable for this action. Contact an administrator.
discordError: Discord did not confirm this action. Please check the result before trying again.
configuration: The server configuration needs an administrator’s attention.
expired: This personal panel has expired. Open 11eNexus again.
archiveFirst: Archive or make this game unavailable before retiring it from the catalogue.
noMentions: Adding or bringing back a game does not automatically subscribe you or mention its players.
quotaHint: One creation or reactivation per member in 24 hours.
approveHint: Open Administration → Requests to approve, ask for details or reject this request.
manualReview: Check the game’s title, official link and image. No public channel has been created yet.
migrationRequired: No games are imported automatically. An administrator must prepare and apply an import plan.
searchLimited: Please wait before searching the external catalogue again.
setupHint: Administrators publish and configure this panel. Members manage their own games and notifications.
unknownError: This action could not be completed. The team can check the diagnostic logs.
panelIntro: Find a game, choose your notifications or bring an old game back.
catalogueCapacity: Nexus catalogue, channel or role capacity has been reached. An administrator must free up space.
duplicateGame: A game with this name already exists. Check the catalogue or ask an administrator to clarify its identity.
alreadyProposed: This game has already been proposed and is awaiting administrator review.
requestUpdated: Your proposal has been updated. The team can resume its review.
importReviewIntro: Choose the channels and roles to adopt. Straightforward matches can be selected together; duplicates, campaigns and special permissions need a decision. This local page does not modify Discord.
importReviewScope: Only these two categories are analysed
importReviewArchiveExplanation: The standby category becomes the first hidden archive. All its textual channels will be hidden, including channels excluded from the catalogue. History is preserved. Archives 2 and 3 are created only when necessary, at 50 channels per category.
importReviewCounts: {{channels}} textual channels to review · {{ignored}} non-textual spaces ignored.
importReviewOnboarding: Remove imported game references from onboarding after importing subscriptions
importReviewExportHint: Download the manifest, then use the plan command. Permissions and role hierarchy are rechecked on Discord before applying anything. Choose RAWG references explicitly; no same-name result is selected automatically.
importReviewMissing: A name or role choice is missing.
importReviewInvalidRawg: The RAWG reference is invalid or used twice.
importReviewEmpty: Select at least one channel to export.
importReviewSelected: {{count}} game(s) selected. The manifest is ready for verification with the plan command.
importIssueunmatched: No role identified: choose an existing role or let Nexus create one for this game.
importIssuefuzzy: Suggested match: check the game name and role.
importIssueduplicate: Several channels share the proposed role: choose the canonical channel or separate the games.
importIssueevent: Possible campaign or temporary space: preserved, review before inclusion.
importIssuefamily: Grouped games or a series: choose one game identity.
importIssuepermissions: This role has global permissions; the plan will reject its import in this state.
importIssuehierarchy: The role is above the bot: move the bot up before applying.
importIssuereferences: The role is used in channel permissions; review those access rules.
importIssuecatalogueUnavailable: RAWG search failed; other matches remain available.
importReviewCreateRole: Create a role for this game
importReviewNewRoleHint: The role is created when applying the plan, with no global permissions or initial subscribers. Choose a RAWG game or reuse a parent game role’s icon below.
importReviewRawgIcon: Use the selected RAWG game image
importReviewIconRequired: To create the role, choose a RAWG game or a parent role with an icon.
a.title: Administration · 11eNexus
a.entryHelp: Open your private workspace to manage requests, games and Nexus.
a.homeHelp: Choose a section. Opening a page does not change the server.
a.requestsHelp: Review proposed games and reply to members. Open requests are shown by default.
a.catalogueHelp: Find a game to manage its page, channel and role, or add a new game.
a.maintenanceHelp: Check differences with Discord and resolve problems. Diagnostics change nothing; actions require a separate confirmation.
a.panelsHelp: Choose a panel and its channel. Review the consequences before publishing or moving its message.
a.attachHelp: Choose the existing game. The request will be accepted without creating a channel, role or subscription.
a.requestHelp: Check the title and link. Prepare approval, ask for details or reject with a reason.
a.gameHelp: These actions affect the server. You will see their consequences before confirming.
a.gamePending: {{count}} operations need review. Use Repair to restore a verified association.
a.retiredHelp: This entry is retired. Its channel, messages and role have been preserved.
a.prepareHelp: Check the name, link and image. You can review the result before any channel or role is created.
a.iconReady: Image prepared and stored by Nexus.
a.iconMissing: Choose a RAWG image, a parent game image or upload an image before continuing.
a.adminQuota: Your Admin role is exempt from addition, revival and request quotas. Capacity limits still apply.
a.parentHelp: Choose an existing game image only. Its subscribers and roles will not be copied.
a.repairHelp: Select the channel and role that actually belong to this game. Missing resources will not be recreated.
a.repairPermissions: Repair reapplies Nexus channel permissions and makes the role mentionable. Subscribers will be read from Discord.
a.diagnostic: {{changes}} differences · {{missing}} missing resources · {{roles}} untracked roles and {{channels}} untracked channels
a.noChanges: No differences in the checked resources.
a.rotationSummary: {{count}} games proposed for archiving · {{unverified}} incomplete histories protected from rotation.
a.pendingHelp: Some operations need review. Choose a game to open its repair page.
a.diagnosticHelp: Run a check to read current resources and activity. No channel moves or role changes will be made.
a.memberPanelHelp: The selected channel will become the read-only member entry point. Its permissions will be replaced with Nexus panel permissions.
a.staffPanelHelp: Choose a channel already private to admins. Nexus will verify its privacy without changing its permissions.
a.confirmHelp: Review the consequences below. Cancel or Back applies no changes.
a.confirmExpiry: This review expires after 5 minutes. If the state changes, check again before confirming.
a.reasonHelp: The member will see this reason in their request status.
a.imageHelp: A PNG, JPEG or WebP image up to 5 MB. Nexus will validate and store it.
a.editHelp: Edit the title and aliases. You can choose whether to align Discord names in the review.
a.searchHelp: Search names in this list. Back preserves your page and filter.
a.applying: Applying changes. Confirmed results will appear here.
a.done: Action completed. The displayed data has been reloaded.
a.partialHelp: Some resources still need attention. Open Maintenance to check the result before trying again.
a.createConsequences: An active channel and mentionable role will be created. Without a first human message within 48 hours, the game returns to archives.
a.archiveConsequences: The channel will move to hidden archives. Messages, role and subscribers are preserved.
a.retireConsequences: The game will leave the catalogue. Its channel, history and role are preserved. This does not free a physical Discord channel.
a.archiveFirstHelp: This game is active. Archive it from its page before retiring it from the catalogue.
a.suspendConsequences: Management and member actions will be suspended for this game. The channel and history remain.
a.resumeConsequences: Management and member actions will resume. Unfinished operations must be repaired first.
a.reconcileConsequences: The database will be updated from Discord and interrupted operations checked. Inactivity archiving will not run.
a.rotateConsequences: Reconciliation will run, then only eligible games with verified history will be archived under the normal rules.
a.panelConsequences: The existing message will be updated or moved. No duplicate panel will be published in its current channel.
a.staleAction: The state changed or this confirmation has already been used. Go back and prepare a new review.
staleAction: The state changed or this confirmation was already used. Go back and check again before confirming.
staffChannelPublic: This channel is not restricted to admins. Choose a private staff channel; its permissions were not changed.
a.change_unavailable: Channel out of scope or missing
a.noRawgResults: No matching entry? Return to manual entry to provide the name, link and image.
a.auditIncomplete: Classification of untracked resources is incomplete. Check the marker role and scope; these counts are not a complete inventory.
a.recycleConsequences: To free a role, Nexus may recycle the archived game role for “{{game}}”. Its image and preferences will be preserved.
repairRolePermissions: This role has global permissions. Choose a notification role without permissions.
repairHierarchy: The bot cannot edit this role. Choose an ordinary role below Nexus’s role.
repairConflict: This channel or role is already linked to another game. Check the game pages before continuing.
repairChannelScope: This channel is outside the game categories managed by Nexus.
repairChannelPermission: Nexus cannot manage this channel. Check its permissions before repairing.
requesterUnavailable: The requester no longer has access to Nexus. Check their membership and role before approving this request.
a.moreAliases: {{count}} more aliases available in Edit game.
a.nameDifference: Discord names can be aligned from the game page
a.imageFormats: PNG, JPEG or WebP · up to 5 MB
repairRoleReferences: This role is used by other channel permissions or onboarding. Choose a notification role dedicated to this game.
a.identityFilled: ✅ Name and link filled in — review them in the summary
a.identityMissing: ⏳ Name and link need to be completed or corrected
a.nextIdentity: Next step: use “Name and link” to complete the game’s identity.
a.nextVisual: Choose an image next: RAWG search, a parent icon or an upload. The review button stays unavailable until then.
a.nextReview: Everything is filled in. Open the summary to review and confirm; no channel or role has been created yet.
requestHelp_expired: This request expired after 30 days without an update. You can submit a new request if you are still interested.
a.historyRetention: Inactive requests expire after 30 days. Closed history is kept for 30 days.
a.diagnostic_waiting: Preparing and waiting for current operations to finish…
a.diagnosticLeave: You can return to the menu. Leaving this screen stops this check; its result will not replace the menu you opened.
a.diagnosticComplete: ✅ Check complete. The results are shown below.
a.diagnosticFailed: The check failed. You can retry with “Check now” or return to the menu. If the problem persists, check the bot logs.
a.statusHelp: Here is the recorded catalogue state and the actions awaiting attention. To check Discord resources, open Maintenance from Admin home.
newGameAlertsHelp: Receive new game announcements in {{channel}}. You can turn these alerts off at any time. Revivals are not announced.
newGameAlertsOn: Your new game alerts are on. Notifications also depend on your Discord settings.
newGameAlertsOff: Your new game alerts are off.
newGameAlertsUnavailable: The new game alerts role is unavailable or cannot be assigned. Please contact the team.
newGameAnnouncementNeedsReview: “{{game}}” was added, but its announcement needs checking in the announcements channel. No automatic resend will be attempted to avoid a duplicate.
browseHelp_recent: The latest additions, newest first. Choose a game to open its channel or enable its notifications.
emptyHelp_recent: No dated additions yet. Use “All” to browse the existing catalogue.
recentUndatedHelp: Historical games without an addition date are still available in “All”. Revivals do not move up this list.
recentSearchModalHelp: Search the server’s dated additions, newest first.
discordRateLimited: Discord requires waiting {{seconds}} s before trying this action again.
e.title: Events
e.hubHelp: Create an event, check its progress or find its archives.
e.summary: Events: {{active}} open · {{archived}} archived · {{pending}} operation(s) to review.
e.listHelp: Choose an event to manage it. Finished events stay archived for safekeeping.
e.empty: No events here. Create one or choose another filter.
e.chooseGame: Which game is this event for? This is informational and does not bring the game back.
e.noGames: No games found. Try another search or add the game to the catalogue first.
e.createPreview: A new channel open to Syndiqués will be created in the events category, with a notification role just for this event. A bilingual message will let members choose notifications and will be pinned. No automatic ping.
e.willAnnounce: An announcement with a link will be posted in the game channel, without mentions.
e.noAnnouncement: No game announcement: no suitable active text channel is available. The game will not be brought back.
e.closePreview: The channel will be hidden from members and kept in the archives. Its notification role will be deleted. This event cannot be reopened.
e.repairPreview: Resume only this event’s unfinished steps after checking Discord. Previous subscriptions will not be reassigned. Manually deleted resources will not be recreated.
e.editPreview: The channel name, notification role and pinned message will be updated. Messages and subscribers are kept.
e.cleanupWarning: ⚠️ Archives full. The channel {{channel}} for **{{name}}**, archived on {{date}}, and its entire history will be permanently deleted to make room. This cannot be undone.
e.previewExpiry: This preview is valid for five minutes. Cancelling publishes nothing.
e.partial: The action is incomplete. Confirmed steps have been kept.
e.partialHelp: Check the effects above before resuming. Do not create the event again.
e.cleanupDone: The old channel has already been deleted. This event still needs archiving; no further deletion was authorized.
e.formHelp: Give it a name and a short introduction. You will review all changes before creation.
e.name: Event name
e.searchHelp: Search by name. Leave blank to show everything.
e.publicHelp: The channel is open to all Syndiqués. Use the button to choose mentions for this event only.
e.announcement: An event is open! Visit its channel to learn more and choose notifications.
e.notificationsOn: Mentions for this event are enabled for you.
e.notificationsOff: Mentions for this event are disabled for you.
e.notificationsHelp: This choice does not change channel access or game notifications.
e.closed: This event has finished or its creation is not ready yet. Notifications cannot be changed.
e.roleMissing: This event’s role or access has changed on Discord. An admin needs to review it.
e.channelMissing: This event’s channel is missing or has moved. Nexus respects this change; an admin needs to review it.
e.categoriesMissing: An expected category is missing or inaccessible. No category was recreated.
e.archiveFull: The archives are full and no older managed event can be offered for cleanup. An admin needs to intervene.
e.duplicate: An open event already uses this channel name. Choose a different name.
e.ambiguous: A previous step could not be confirmed on Discord. No duplicate was created; a manual review is needed.
e.checking: Checking… No changes have been applied yet.
e.messageMissing: The notification message is missing or no longer pinned. An admin must explicitly repair it.
e.replaceMessage: The pinned message was deleted. Confirming will publish and pin a new message in this event, without reassigning subscriptions.
e.tagRequired: This forum requires a tag for the announcement. Choose one before confirming.
e.rolePending: ⚠️ The notification role still needs deleting.
e.roleReady: Notification role created for this event.
e.pinPending: Message published; pinning still needs finishing.
e.closeOnlyPreview: The archives are full. This confirmation closes the event and deletes only its notification role. Its channel and history remain hidden in place, awaiting space in the archives. No older channel will be deleted.
e.closedPending: The event is closed and hidden. Archiving still needs finishing.
